title: 2009 Prairie's bay window now sits on a band of carved flowers
items: In 1904, the stone bay window over the front door of 2009 Prairie Avenue now carries a carved band under its three windows: two staggered rows of small four-petalled flowers, seventeen in all, where the old photograph shows them. Before, the stone under the windows was plain.
The chimney's place, the window hoods and the gable's south foot are still to come.
